movie.title: Faisha Gesi
movie.overview: Urban taxi driver Mahin has just one day to arrange a large sum of money. But as he encounters a series of unexpected incidents during his rides, what will Mahin do to achieve his goal?

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Facing a strict one-day deadline to raise a large sum of money, urban taxi driver Mahin navigates a series of unpredictable and chaotic passenger encounters across the city.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Urban taxi driver Mahin finds himself in a desperate race against time when he is given just twenty-four hours to secure a significant amount of money. As he hits the bustling city streets, each ride introduces him to eccentric passengers and unexpected complications that continuously derail his plans. Balancing humor with mounting pressure, Mahin must adapt quickly to every bizarre twist if he hopes to reach his goal before the day ends.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Mahin is an ordinary urban taxi driver whose life is thrown into sudden turmoil when an urgent financial demand forces him to raise a massive sum of money within a single day. Driven by sheer desperation, he takes to the city streets, hoping that a full shift of fares will somehow yield the funds he needs. However, his shift quickly devolves into an unpredictable odyssey as each new passenger brings an entirely fresh set of troubles and outlandish scenarios into his cab. From eccentric locals with bizarre requests to chaotic situations that test his patience and morality, Mahin is dragged deeper into the complex web of urban life. As the hours tick away, the pressure intensifies, forcing him to make quick, high-stakes decisions to keep his goal within reach. Along the way, the humorous mishaps and poignant encounters reveal Mahin's resilience, ingenuity, and deep-seated motivations. Every mile driven becomes a delicate balance between comedic absurdity and dramatic stakes. Ultimately, Mahin must navigate both the literal traffic and the metaphorical obstacles of the city to overcome the odds stacked against him before midnight strikes.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: In this engaging blend of comedy and drama, urban taxi driver Mahin faces the ultimate test of resourcefulness when he is given a strict one-day deadline to gather a substantial amount of cash. With time running out, Mahin takes to the busy city streets, turning his taxi into a revolving door of unexpected encounters, quirky personalities, and escalating dilemmas. As each passenger brings new challenges that threaten to derail his efforts, Mahin is forced to improvise and adapt to a rapidly unfolding series of events. Driven by desperation and heart, the story follows his journey through the unpredictable highs and lows of urban life, offering a high-stakes, entertaining, and spoiler-free look at how far one driver will go to achieve his goal against the clock.
